Senior Data Science Consultant at Strata Consulting Group. 9 years shaping data-driven strategies across industries. Specialize in translating complex insights into actionable business outcomes.  

Leverage Python to build predictive models that optimize client workflows, reducing manual tasks by 30% in two major projects. Drive A/B testing initiatives that boosted customer retention by 18% and campaign ROI by 25%, with full ownership of execution and analysis.  

Design data visualization solutions using Plotly to create interactive dashboards, enabling stakeholders to track KPIs in real time. These tools became foundational for three clients’ reporting frameworks.  

Master NumPy and Pandas to process and clean datasets, streamlining analysis pipelines and improving data readiness for cross-functional teams.  

Feature engineering is my backbone—architected scalable solutions that underpin machine learning models, while mentoring junior teams to elevate their analytical rigor.  

Statistical modeling guides strategic decisions, from risk assessment to market forecasting. Always aligning technical depth with business goals to deliver measurable impact.  

Driven by curiosity and results, I bridge data complexity with clear value. Let’s solve problems that matter.
